Recursive equation of the snoc recurrence: preserve the head and append through the tail.

A proof-local mathematical shortcut for negative-one indexing of a concrete nonempty sequence whose tail is expressed by snocVS. It is not an ordinary rule of the supplied MPY operational semantics, and Stage 1 contains no earlier bridge-free proof of this exact rule. It is directly relevant to solution.py's array[-1] and to the two quantified length-at-least-two claims in spec.k.
